name: Tablet Keyboard
description: iPad-style on-screen keyboard: swipe down on a key for its number or symbol, double-tap space for a period, auto-capitals, small autocorrections, caps lock, hold space to move the cursor, hold a letter for accents, hold backspace to delete words, key previews, an undo/redo/paste bar and a split keyboard in landscape. Adds an Esc/Tab/Ctrl/arrows row in terminals. Hold the hide key for settings.
